integrity: The symbolic proof and accompanying standalone finite checker were reviewed together. No external or independent review was performed.
scientific_limitations: The result computes first Hochschild cohomology, including a dihedral module and modular extension, not magnitude cohomology or higher Hochschild groups. Published general Schurian Hurewicz theory covers a broad description of first cohomology; earlier special-biserial literature may imply some dimensions. Historical priority for the equivariant refinement is not independently certified. Finite checker is corroboration only.
title: Dihedral first Hochschild cohomology of cyclic distance algebras
